subject: crap crap and more crap
author: kevlar0
body:
What a load of old bollocks, Again the boys at criterion give us more useless crap. Whats next, burnout on horseback?

You would have thought they would of put more effort into sorting the numerous problems that are occuring every time you put the game in the tray, but no. All the see is more people willing to part with there cash for a half finished game.

my dog ate my disc.

subject: Requirements
author: The Kid 74
body:
To be able to play this online you would need a high end graphics card, tons of memory and a fast internet connection. Compared to the PS3 and XBOX 360, I hope they take these things into consideration. I would not want to buy a new PC just to play the new PC version. I would have a better time with my 360. If they want to improve the game do it for the gamers not for the the PC. Make the gamer version more customizable.

Think Hard before you Act.
